about: ASSET-006 early repaint recipe: the Hive Brute's method (kit_tools/troll_repaint.py) scaled to the Seeker (distances / 2.5). Mask = repaint/brood_hive_mask.png in the Seeker's UV0 (R bark from the crust, G: the wings (1) and the darkened leg ends, B blight veins + the brood glow halo = emission, A dark roots); lines at 2048, box-filtered to 1024.
bark_texture: olivetree_trunk01 (TheHive_Mat _MainTex), triplanar in rest-pose metres, tile 0.48 m

wings.recolour: torn bark-skin: luminance x [0.36, 0.27, 0.19] (the orange membrane goes dark leathery brown) x the bark grain at 40 %, ragged holes: alpha 0 where a 3-octave noise > 0.42 within the outer half of the wing

seeker_emission_note: multiplier on its own blood-orange _EmissionColor (it lit the pincers and wing veins orange)

mandibles.recolour: its own pincers and teeth: min(luminance / mean, 1.3) x [0.36, 0.27, 0.14] (dirty yellow-brown)

brood_halo: 0.5 x smoothstep(0.16, 0.04 m) round each brood cell, in the emission mask
